description: Revoke an API key; its sessions end and its calls fail. Idempotent and safe to retry. Needs a management key (mtblm_) or the login of an owner or admin; an API key gets management_key_required. org_id is optional: a key uses its own organisation, and a login with one organisation uses that one. On rate_limited, wait retry_after seconds before retrying.

key_id.description: the API key's ID, from list_api_keys

name: revoke_api_key
